evidence.note: Introduces the Anytime Index, an AUC-style metric quantifying how solution quality improves as reasoning-token budget increases, and Preference Data Prompting (PDP), an inference-time self-improvement method using self-generated contrastive reasoning pairs at fixed token budgets, giving consistent gains across seven LLM families on trip planning, math, and scientific QA.
evidence.title: Budget-Aware Anytime Reasoning with LLM-Synthesized Preference Data
